title: Hono Migration
content:
Switching from Hono to Photon takes less than 5 minutes. We maintained 99% API compatibility while delivering significant performance gains.

Drop-in Replacement

Simply change your imports and initialization:

// From Hono
import { Hono } from 'hono'
const app = new Hono()

// To Photon
import { Gravito } from '@gravito/photon'
const app = new Gravito()

API Differences

  • Context: FastContext is optimized for pooling.
  • Middleware: Identical signature, faster execution.
  • Native Fetch: Photon directly exports a fetch handler.
